name: How to Fill a PDF Form
description: Fill AcroForm fields and add signatures to any PDF — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your fillable PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. All interactive fields are detected and rendered automatically.

step.name: Fill in the fields
step.text: Type into text fields, toggle checkboxes, pick dropdown options. For signature fields tap 'Tap to sign' and draw, type, or upload your signature.

step.name: Download the filled PDF
step.text: Click 'Fill PDF Form'. Your completed document downloads directly to your device — no server involved.
